data.title: 信浓 · 冬日暖桌的九尾包裹
data.description: 冬日居室内暖桌散发融融暖意，窗外轻雪纷飞。信浓穿着软糯开衫依偎在身旁，将九条巨大蓬松的雪白狐尾完全展开裹住你取暖，亲手喂你吃剥好的甜橘，满脸恬静。
data.location: cozy winter living room with kotatsu and soft snowfall outside window
data.action: sitting closely at kotatsu table, wrapping partner entirely inside her nine enormous fluffy fox tails to share body heat, peeling a sweet mikan orange
data.lighting: warm cozy domestic lamplight contrasting with cold outdoor snow
data.mood: ultimate warmth, fluffy cuddle bliss, tender domestic peace
data.promptProse: Sitting snug at a kotatsu table surrounded by winter snow, Shinano bundles her partner in all nine fluffy tails while feeding a sweet mandarin.
data.animaCaption: Shinano bundling partner with nine fluffy tails at a winter kotatsu table.
